title: Beyond Multiple-Choice Accuracy: Real-World Challenges of Implementing Large Language Models in Healthcare

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing prior studies that assess racially skewed diagnoses in medical report generation and utilizing adversarial datasets (e.g., EquityMedQA) to measure demographic inaccuracies, stereotypical language, and inappropriate genetic associations.

Discussing frameworks and literature that use adversarial datasets to evaluate LLM responses for inaccuracies, stereotypical language, and the amplification of societal gender biases in healthcare settings.
Reviewing evaluations that test LLM outputs for outcome disparities, demographic inaccuracies, and the reflection of societal age biases in AI-driven medical tools.
